text:
Avery (Design): dropping an updated compact trace UI exploration — trying to keep height down while keeping export & copy actions discoverable. mock: https://imgur.com/compact-trace-v3 Liam - Eng: nice direction. quick constraints: mobile touch targets must be >=44px, and avoid DOM churn while dragging the scrubber. Sofia PM: support feedback: people often want to export only the failure window, not full traces. can we expose "Export selection" vs "Export full trace" in the primary flow? Rohit Support: strongly +1. Also request: when copying correlation ids, let us copy short id, full id, or id+permalink in one click. saves copying into tickets. Avery (Design): proposal: compact toolbar shows icon-only Play/Pause with aria-labels, a short time readout, small export icon. Clicking export opens a tiny menu: "Download trace snapshot (.har)" and "Download selection (.har)" with a chevron for .json. On mobile export opens a bottom sheet. a11y-bot: accessibility notes: Play button aria-label="Play trace" / "Pause trace". Make the timestamp a live region with aria-live="polite" and throttle announcements while dragging (<=250ms). Ensure contrast >=4.5:1 and focusable controls with visible focus ring. Liam - Eng: we'll throttle to 250ms and format announcements like "0 minutes 12 seconds" so screen readers speak natural language. implementation snippet: `
0:12.2
` throttled in JS. Avery (Design): good. what about the correlation id pill? Inline copy icon on desktop and a mini-menu for copy variants on focus seems useful. Mobile opens sheet with the same options. Rohit Support: prefer inline copy for desktop. Flow: click copy icon -> copy full id + permalink by default. But keep short-id visible to reduce visual noise. Sofia PM: decision: default copy = full id + permalink. Add separate options for copy short and copy only id. Also ensure keyboard flow: Tab to pill -> Enter opens menu -> Arrow keys to options -> Enter to copy. Announce success via aria-live. a11y-bot: add role=\"menu\"/role=\"menuitem\" where appropriate. Provide a status region `
Copied trace id and permalink
` for copy feedback. Liam - Eng: noted. For exports, backend produces HAR and JSON. UI will surface HAR as primary and a small chevron to pick JSON. We'll include trace id, permalink, selected time window metadata inside exported file. Avery (Design): label wording: options were "Download trace (.har)", "Export trace snapshot (.har)", "Download snapshot (.har)". My pick: "Download trace snapshot (.har)" — clear to engineers and friendly. Thoughts? Sofia PM: fine with that. consistent enough. Add a subtitle in menu: "Contains network timings and spans" to help non-technical users. a11y-bot: ensure file type readouts are announced. Rohit Support: add "Copy stack as text" action in export menu and inline next to collapsed frames. Inline copy speeds triage. Make it a link-style button with aria-label="Copy stack as text". Liam - Eng: inline copy is fine. We'll provide two clipboard formats: plain text and markdown with file:line links. Example payloads provided in PR. Also add an on-focus Ctrl/Cmd+C quick-copy for timestamp element. Make timestamp `tabindex=0` and aria-label="Copy timestamp". Avery (Design): shortcuts: K toggles playback, Left/Right scrub small steps, Shift+Left/Right larger jumps, Home/End jump to start/end. Show tiny hint "K" on hover of play and list all shortcuts in Settings. Caveat: Space might conflict with focused buttons so K is safer. Sofia PM: include keyboard shortcuts in the bottom-sheet on mobile as well (discoverability). a11y-bot: make sure keybindings are documented and that pressable elements have clear focus states. If K is used, ensure it doesn't interfere with text inputs (ignore when typing). Liam - Eng: performance note: for long traces we'll virtualize timeline ticks and compute scrubber position via index, not by rendering thousands of DOM nodes. Also offload heavy work to web worker if needed. Rohit Support: one more small ask: when copying trace info, include a one-line header for ticket subjects: `Trace 9a7f1c2b — 2026-03-22T15:12:03Z` then blank line then stack or permalink. Very handy. Avery (Design): will add that format to copy specs. Also adding microcopy: Play button tooltip "Play trace (K)" and export tooltip "Download trace snapshot (.har)". Sofia PM: decision summary posted: 1) compact mode = icon-only play/pause with aria-labels; 2) export primary = Download trace snapshot (.har) + selection option + .json chevron; 3) correlation pill shows short id with inline copy on desktop & menu with copy variants; 4) timestamp is aria-live polite + throttled announcements + focus-to-copy; 5) inline "Copy stack as text" next to collapsed frames; 6) keyboard shortcuts default to K and arrows; 7) mobile uses bottom sheet for export; 8) exported metadata includes trace id, permalink, selection timestamps. Liam - Eng: no objections. I'll pair with design on the ARIA attributes and submit a perf PR for virtualization. a11y-bot: small follow-up: announce file formats as "HAR format, includes network and timing data" when opening export menu. preview-bot: Preview build deployed: https://redwood-inference.dev/trace-preview/1987654321 (expires in 24h) :rocket: Avery (Design): pairing review 11:30am — will update frames after that. closing thread, thanks all. :white_check_mark:
